contract: Open UI never executes JavaScript. Consuming apps use public native Rust methods and Rust callbacks. Needed browser element behavior must be implemented and exposed natively; fixtures and pixel exclusions never waive public API work. Pinned Chromium is the sole pixel target, with zero tolerance; old Open UI images are provenance.
